params.prompt: Instantly understandable mobile app ad visual, square 1:1, premium glossy 3D render. COMPOSITION: the hero group is placed in the LOWER-CENTER, occupying only from 38% to 86% of the height and the middle 70% of the width; the upper 34% must stay free of objects (only background atmosphere) for a headline; bottom 12% free. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no money, no coins. Include the cute 3D mascot from the reference image (Meri: big round fluffy orange petal-shaped hair like a flower, round peach face with rosy cheeks, red sweater with white letter M). Scene: a large glossy smartphone standing upright showing a clean white app screen with a two-bar chart: a tall orange bar with a small people-group icon on top and a short red bar with a single person icon; a red notification badge with a question mark symbol near the short bar. Meri stands beside the phone looking up, puzzled. BACKGROUND: vibrant gradient from warm orange to hot coral pink with diagonal soft light beams, floating glossy translucent spheres and small 3D chart shapes at various depths, soft bokeh.
